<!-- Generated by Ankus.DocGenerator. -->

Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Owns trigger metadata and detached OLD and NEW row values independently of PostgreSQL memory contexts.
Transition table names remain owned strings, but the tables can only be queried during the trigger invocation.

```csharp
public sealed class PgTriggerContext
```

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

### UpdatedColumns

Gets the zero-based ordinals of the columns the triggering <code>UPDATE</code> assigns, or null for other operations.
A column can be assigned its current value; compare [Old](/api/ankus.pgtriggercontext/#member-f3fd9385901d8ce4) and [New](/api/ankus.pgtriggercontext/#member-b4f4d77019cf4355) to find changed values.
